title: Fixed Sloped Nest and Front Collection Trough
description: One newly authored complete static agricultural laying-nest display. Four full legs carry one deep open-front shaded chamber, a continuous visibly inclined floor descending toward the front, and a lower external full-width receiving trough with a genuine open channel and intact raised front lip. The chamber has full side/back walls and an overhanging sloped roof; the collector has a fixed partly raised shallow cover attached along its back hinge line. One complete small oval egg-shaped display solid sits in the exposed collector to clarify the illustrative relation, not an extra asset. New whole floor-to-collector layout, not extra bays of the old flat-floor hutch or a round-entry bird box. One static model, zero scenes. No real egg transport, working hinge, animal-housing suitability, welfare, hygiene, food safety, construction or load claim.
